**ID:** T2774

**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng shū* (T2774) is a third anonymous Vimalakīrti commentary from the Dunhuang corpus. It is distinct from [KR6i0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0089) (T2770) and [KR6i0090](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0090) (T2771) in manuscript provenance and exegetical detail, although all three share the *shū* genre and broadly similar doctrinal apparatus. The Taishō header cross-references No. 475.

**Abstract**

T2774 is part of the Dunhuang Vimalakīrti commentary cluster (T2768–T2778), each text representing an independent commentarial tradition preserved only in fragmentary form on the Hexi corridor. The commentary's exegetical style is more terse than T2770/T2771 and includes more direct gloss-format entries, suggesting use as a teaching aid.
